supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42:32 UTC, tess.hart created the account guest.rwong; the account-creation event is associated with the same logon ID as tess.hart's preceding logon to DC-ORC-01 from WS-THART-01.

The account name follows the documented guest.<name> temporary-account convention, and the observed group addition is to Volunteers. This matches the documented help-desk account-creation practice, so the alerted creation is consistent with an authorized benign action.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show the account creation and a Volunteers group addition, but do not provide a complete group-membership or privilege snapshot for guest.rwong.
The provided records do not show whether guest.rwong authenticated or was used after creation.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish that guest.rwong received any group membership or privilege beyond the observed Volunteers addition.
The evidence does not establish who requested the temporary account or what work it was intended to support.
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: tess.hart launched Remote Desktop sessions from WS-THART-01 to DC-ORC-01 and FILE-ORC-01. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-SBYRNE-01; these sessions do not, by themselves, establish that the alerted account creation was malicious. (T288-00023, T288-00025, T288-00026, T288-00072, T288-00077, T288-00078)
